description: A customizable WPF media player control powered by FlyleafLib, with built-in playback controls, a media queue, and dockable panels.
releaseNotes:
Downloads & Recordings
		- Introduces a shared download manager with configurable concurrent downloads
		- Adds a Downloads panel with Docked, Floating and Overlay modes
		- Supports individual and batch downloads with start, pause, resume and stop controls
		- Supports Automatic and Custom download modes with embedded and external stream selection
		- Supports automatic filename and container selection with optional overrides
		- Supports scheduled recordings with configurable start date/time and recording duration
		- Integrates downloading directly into the queue context menu

		DVD & Blu-ray Playback
		- Adds DVD and Blu-ray playback with runtime FFmpeg capability detection
		- Adds Open Disc and Add Disc commands with automatic disc type detection
		- Supports title, playlist, chapter and angle selection
		- Adds native Blu-ray MPLS metadata parsing and playlist duration filtering
		- Supports adding multiple disc titles to the queue
		- Displays friendly disc and playlist titles throughout the UI

		Queue & Search
		- Adds live queue search and filtering without affecting playback order or queue persistence
		- Adds Quick Queue Search with keyboard navigation and configurable Ctrl+F keybinding
		- Reorganizes queue toolbar and context menus with consistent Open, Add and Paste operations

		On-Screen Display (OSD)
		- Redesigns the OSD with independent clock, queue, status, action and error regions
		- Adds configurable playback clock positioning and optional millisecond precision
		- Adds queue position, item count and media title with configurable visibility
		- Improves dynamic positioning based on player activity and playback bar visibility
		- Improves transient and blocking error presentation and automatic clearing
		- Extends OSD configuration and settings

		Capture Devices
		- Adds audio and video capture device selection through the main context menu and corresponding panels
		- Supports dynamic device enumeration and camera capture format selection

		API & Other Improvements
		- Exposes ShowError API for consistent error reporting from hosting applications
		- Improves main context menu consistency
		- Improves keyboard focus and keybinding handling
		- Fixes LIVE indicator visibility when closing an input
